UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never apply universal transition: all. Use specific transition-colors or transition-transform.
Do not center-align the whole app container; keep left-aligned editorial flow.
Do not use generic SaaS blue or purple gradients. Stick to precision Obsidian Black (#0B0D11) with Gold/Amber (#F59E0B) highlights and WhatsApp Green (#25D366) badges.
Use data-testid attributes on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, filters, tabs, forms, modals).
Integrations with Google Calendar and WhatsApp Cloud API MUST be clearly surfaced with status badges and MOCKED indicators in the Admin panel where applicable.
All copy must be polished Portuguese (pt-BR) with automotive terminology like 'Desamassamento sem Pintura (DSP)', 'Preservação da Tinta de Fábrica', 'Agendamento Online'.
